Travelers are advised to bring, and to hold onto, their coin purses. }} [[Yahnur Market]] is an optional outpost is situated to the southwest of where [[Prince Bokka the Magnificent]] resides. ==Getting there== This outpost connects [[Vehtendi Valley]] with [[Resplendent Makuun]]. It is located in the southeastern corner and southwestern corner of those two areas respectively. The [[secondary quest]] [[Summertime for Bokka]] leads to a point in the Resplendent Makuun very near this outpost. ==Exits== *[[Resplendent Makuun]] (northeast) *[[Vehtendi Valley]] (northwest and southwest) ==NPCs== ===Allies=== ====Services==== *{{x}} 20 [[Jinte]] ([[merchant]]) *{{x}} 10 [[Resh]] ([[skill trainer]]) *{{x}} 15 [[Xunlai Agent]] ([[storage upgrades]]) *{{x}} 24 [[Xunlai Chest]] ([[storage]]) =====Henchmen===== :''(all level 20)'' *{{w}} [[Devona]] (Fighter) *{{r}} [[Aidan]] (Archer) *{{mo}} [[Kihm]] (Monk) *{{mo}} [[Mhenlo]] (Healer) *{{n}} [[Eve]] (Blood) *{{me}} [[Odurra]] (Illusion) *{{e}} [[Cynn]] (Fire) *{{e}} [[Herta]] (Earth) *{{p}} [[Sogolon]] (Motivation) *{{d}} [[Gehraz]] (Holy) ====Other allies==== *{{w}} 20 [[Vabbian Guard (warrior)|Vabbian Guard]]s *{{w}} 10 [[Vabbian Commoner]]s *{{w}} 10 [[Vabbian Miner]]s *{{x}} 2 [[Vabbian Child]]ren ==Notes== {{gw2w|Yahnur Plateau}} *A relatively large area in the southern and southwestern corners of this outpost should be explored if going for the Elonian [[Cartographer]] title track. This outpost ([[Yahnur Market]]) will get 0.3% towards the Elonian [[Cartographer]] title track. *Yahnur Market, [[Piken Square (pre-Searing)]], [[Brauer Academy]], [[Sifhalla]], [[Tarnished Haven]], [[Tihark Orchard (outpost)|Tihark Orchard]], [[Grand Court of Sebelkeh (outpost)|Grand Court of Sebelkeh]], and [[The Mouth of Torment]] are the only outposts with two exits leading to the same zone. *The Northern pier doesn't show up on the minimap. {{Towns and outposts in Vabbi}}
